title: [server] Enforce vteam_* permission server-side in platform-mcp
commit: feat(mcp): enforce platform tool permission on the server

enforcement.site: server/src/platform-mcp/platform-mcp.controller.ts toolsCall() — after zod parse, BEFORE tool.handler, on the same resolved `tool` object (bare name) that `this.tools.find(t => t.name === name)` selected
enforcement.identity_resolution: PlatformMcpService.resolveToolCallerId (new public method): args.taskId/args.teamId → existing resolveExecContext (reuses assertWorkerTask/assertWorkerTeam unchanged); both empty → most-recent-session fallback (SESSION.findFirst({workerId}) orderBy createdAt desc), exactly the channelSend/wecomReply backfill source; no resolvable member → 403
enforcement.lookup_key_bridge: vteam_${receivedBareName} — exactly once, in PlatformToolPermissionService.assertToolAllowed; no prefix strip anywhere (contract §1: the server receives the bare name)
enforcement.matrix_source: Agent.policyId / Agent.agentKey → ExecutionPolicyService.resolveByAgent({policyId, agentKey}) → ResolvedExecutionPolicy.tools (DB config.tools wins; constant ROLE_BOUNDARIES fallback for builtin-named rows missing the DB row). NOT keyed on TeamMember.roleId (AgentRole carries no capability fields)
enforcement.effect_semantics: allow / ask → proceed; deny / absent / any other value → 403 (not listed == deny, matching worker guard isToolAllowed / filterToolsMatrix)

stable_error_code.distinct_from: PLATFORM_MCP_FORBIDDEN (ownership / worker↔team↔task binding / impersonation / DM 403s — unchanged codes), PLATFORM_MCP_MISSING_WORKER_ID
stable_error_code.surface: ForbiddenException({code,message}) → controller toErrorCode → JSON-RPC error -32003 (HTTP 200, JSON-RPC envelope), message prefixed [403] PLATFORM_MCP_TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED — machine-distinguishable from the ownership 403s

fail_closed_policy.rule: unresolvable caller / member / agent / policy / matrix / resolution throw → 403 + PLATFORM_MCP_TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED (never pass-through)
fail_closed_policy.rationale: deliberate divergence from worker/src/role-guard/policy.ts:109-121 pass-through, which is safe only because the engine's native permission config sits behind it; todos 4/5 remove that backstop (todo 4 landed: f50f89d emits native-only permission), so the server check is the sole guard for platform tools. Recorded in CONTRACT-tool-naming-and-identity.md §4.
fail_closed_policy.policy_row_missing_builtin_name: resolves, not crashes: existing resolveAgentWithFallback constant fallback (ROLE_BOUNDARIES[<bounded name>].toolAllows)
fail_closed_policy.resolution_throws: logged (warn) + 403 — never falls through to allow

channel_send_decision.case: channel_send carries NO identity in its args ({target,text} only) and does not call resolveExecContext
channel_send_decision.decision: resolveToolCallerId falls back to the worker's most-recent session (SESSION.findFirst({workerId}) orderBy createdAt desc) — the SAME source channelSend itself uses to derive its task (service.ts:5586-5598) — then verifies via assertWorkerTask(teamId) / assertWorkerTeam. Member resolved → the bound Agent's matrix decides. No member resolvable → 403 PLATFORM_MCP_TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED (fail-closed), NOT a silent allow.

live_receipts.wecom_reply_no_identity_ep_plan: gate ALLOWED (vteam_wecom_reply is in ep_plan.tools) → handler ran and returned its own business text ('发送失败: 无法解析当前任务上下文（请传 taskId）') — proves the no-identity path resolves a caller and passes the gate when the matrix allows

scope_invariants.tools_list_unfiltered: live tools/list still returns all 29 bare names for every caller (receipt task3-curl-toolslist.response.json); the gate runs only at tools/call time
scope_invariants.ownership_checks_untouched: assertWorkerTask / assertWorkerTeam / DM checks unmodified; their 403 codes keep current values (live receipt: unknown worker → PLATFORM_MCP_FORBIDDEN unchanged)
scope_invariants.non_platform_keys: browser / git_* never enter the check (only registered platform-mcp tools are gated; they have no tools/call surface here)
scope_invariants.no_agent_name_literal: the only name-derived value is `vteam_${toolName}`; the agent is read from the member row and the decision from the resolved matrix — proven by the mutation-flip test and by the DB-mutation live probe
scope_invariants.no_roleId_lookup: resolveByAgent receives {policyId, agentKey} only (asserted in spec)

cases.allowed_tool_proceeds: ① matrix allow → resolves; ③ real controller: group_post allow → JSON-RPC 200 + handler executed
cases.ask_effect_proceeds: ① matrix ask → resolves (three-state parity with worker guard)
cases.explicit_deny: ① deny → 403 + PLATFORM_MCP_TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED; ③ HTTP → -32003 + code, handler NOT called
cases.absent_from_allowlist: ① key absent → 403 + code; ③ HTTP absent (doclib allowed, group_post absent) → -32003 + code
cases.allowlist_driven_mutation_flip: ① same member/agent/policy row, mutate one tools value allow→deny→another key allow: decision follows the matrix (doclib allowed → denied → task_transition allowed), plus a negative control (plan_mode still denied in the same row)
cases.resolveByAgent_args: ① spy asserts {policyId, agentKey} — no roleId
cases.unresolvable_caller: ① member not found → 403; ② no-identity + no session → 403 TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED; no-identity + session without member → 403 TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED
cases.resolveByAgent_null: ① custom agent with no policy row → 403
cases.resolution_throws: ① resolveByAgent rejects → 403 (warn logged), never allow
cases.ownership_paths_reused: ② task dimension → returns member id; task cross-task no session → unchanged PLATFORM_MCP_FORBIDDEN; team dimension → returns member id
cases.ownership_code_unchanged_end_to_end: ③ handler's ownership ForbiddenException still surfaces PLATFORM_MCP_FORBIDDEN, not the new code
cases.tools_list_unfiltered: ③ tools/list returns 29 names including task_transition

mutation_proof.how: temporarily replaced `if (effect !== 'allow' && effect !== 'ask')` with `if (false)` in platform-tool-permission.service.ts
mutation_proof.result: 3 tests fail (explicit deny / absent / allowlist-flip) while allow/ask stay green; file restored byte-identical
mutation_proof.meaning: the deny/absent/flip assertions are genuinely coupled to the production check

flip_test_before_after.before: the flip test built its ExecutionPolicyService with an internal prisma mock that always returned null (realPolicyService(null)) while mutating a DIFFERENT outer prisma object → resolveByAgent took the builtin constant fallback (vteam-developer allows doclib) → 'denied' phase resolved instead of rejecting → 1 failure
flip_test_before_after.fix: realPolicyService gained an optional alternatePrisma parameter; the flip test now passes the SAME prisma mock it mutates, so mockResolvedValue actually steers resolveByAgent (no production change)
flip_test_before_after.after: 9/9 in ① green, and the three-phase allow→deny→allow + negative-control assertions all hold

manual_qa.surface: POST http://localhost:13000/api/v1/platform-mcp with x-worker-token: compose-worker-token + x-worker-id, JSON-RPC tools/call (server container rebuilt to include this commit: docker compose up -d --no-deps --build server)

ownership_403_unchanged.response: -32003 [403] PLATFORM_MCP_FORBIDDEN 该 worker 无此任务会话，禁止跨任务访问 (code unchanged)

sequence.error: 【越界拦截｜角色：vteam-plan】不能调用 vteam_task_transition。…（intercepted by the still-alive WORKER guard — todo 5 removes that layer; the server gate is its replacement backstop）
MCP error -32003: [403] PLATFORM_MCP_TOOL_NOT_PERMITTED 工具 vteam_group_post 未获授权：Agent（计划员）的工具矩阵未授权（effect=deny）（策略 ep_plan），拒绝调用
sequence.server_only_differential: the guard payload was stale (still allowed) while only the DB matrix for ep_plan was mutated to deny vteam_group_post → the call reached the server and was denied THERE. tmp DB mutation was reverted byte-semantically: raw/task3-diff-ep_plan-{original,dbrestore,restored}.json (semantic_equal: true, 12 keys, group_post=allow).
